text: {"frames":["Skates hiss across the ice of the canal, and a cheer rolls up the Tower walls as the race begins. Wiebe Millsail waves his red flag and points at the wall where the clock in the picture hangs above the frozen windmill. The judge says the skaters must reach the finish before the hand reaches the mark. Sientje-of-the-Dyke leans on her stick, watching the hands and the crowd. What time does the clock in the picture show, written with digits?","Dirkje Vlotbak lifts the lid of the herring barrel and finds it empty, and the fishmonger's boy stares at the empty crate. Somebody has taken the last salted fish from the stall beside the canal. Nobody saw who did it, and the fishwife is already shouting at the watchman. Before the market bell rings, the stall must be looked over and the fishmonger's list checked. What time does the clock in the picture show, written with digits?","The night train has stopped with a jolt between the fourth and fifth floors, and the lamps in the carriage flicker. A tiny voice drifts down the shaft, asking for someone to climb up with a rope. Joost Mallemolen bangs on the brass rail and says the driver is still asleep in his cabin. The signal bell has not rung since the train halted, and the passengers are waiting. What time does the clock in the picture show, written with digits?","A deep creak comes from the hoist beam above the cheese store, followed by a sharp smell of wet wool. A bale has slipped from its rope and hangs crooked over the stairwell. Trijntje Oosterhout grips the rail and calls down that the cheese men must stand clear. The bale has to be lowered before the next cart comes up the canal. What time does the clock in the picture show, written with digits?","A wind-up mouse steps out from under the workbench in the toy workshop, its tin tail clicking on the floorboards. The toymaker, Gerrit Spoelhuis, drops his pliers and stares at it. The mouse runs to the little clock on the shelf and taps its glass with a tiny paw. Nobody knows when the clock was last wound. What time does the clock in the picture show, written with digits?"]}
